text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad, the Shuka Sho is up 
next! I was hoping to run an amazing race 
and get all the fans cheering for me 
again, but—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"...My fans weren't coming anymore. I was 
so shocked, my mind was all jumbled up. 
But then Trainer told me..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Let's show 'em the strength we've worked 
so hard for. ...That's right, all I can do 
now is give it everything. I'm writing 
this letter to set my resolve in stone."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"When I get back, I'll make sure to write 
good results here. ...I'm heading out...!"
